title: IELTS Listening and Speaking for Beginners
subject: English
description_short: This beginner course covers IELTS Listening Part 1 skills such as numbers, spelling, maps and short conversations, and IELTS Speaking Part 1 skills such as talking about yourself, describing places and giving a one-minute talk. It is for upper secondary students who are starting IELTS Listening and Speaking.
outcomes: take notes on numbers, spelling, maps and short conversations in IELTS Listening Part 1
recognise common Listening traps such as 13/30 and corrected answers
answer IELTS Speaking Part 1 questions in 2–3 sentences using simple patterns
describe places accurately with There is/There are and It has
give a structured one-minute talk using short notes and signposts
